name: New York
context: Kevin went up to the Sound Factory from DC but wasn't ready yet; after two years in South Beach he came straight to New York

name: Washington, D.C.
context: Where Kevin moved around 1989-90, did hair, joined the House of Aviance and partied at Trax

name: Madonna
context: Cast Kevin in her Secret video. As Kevin tells it, she called him to her trailer late at night, asked for a smaller bra and all the gold jewellery, and said 'that's much better'

name: James St. James
context: Host. He thinks they first met in Washington, D.C.; Kevin remembers James in a pizza outfit in New York and a tattered wedding dress in DC. Din Da Da is James's favourite

name: Miami Beach / South Beach
context: Kevin took the Amtrak down, met Darvel and Kitty Meow and made his name in the cafes in two years; James remembers 1991-93, the run-down Art Deco hotels before they came to life

name: Randy Barbato
context: Co-host. He asks about the Renaissance royalties - 'stop counting my money', Kevin answers

name: Kevin Aviance – 'Cunty (The Feeling)'
context: Kevin's first dance hit (1996): recorded on the spot at a producer's place over chicken and grape soda, he says; sampled by Beyoncé on Renaissance

name: Kevin Aviance
context: Guest. Drag performer and dance-music star of the House of Aviance, from Richmond, Virginia by way of DC and South Beach to the Sound Factory; his 1996 'Cunty' was sampled on Beyoncé's Renaissance

name: Sound Factory
context: Kevin went up from DC all the time before he moved, and James calls him its queen in the 90s: $20 in, no guest list, a pin-lit runway to the DJ booth, stadium seats, four speaker stacks and songs that lasted forever

name: New York City Pride March
context: Days after the 2006 attack Kevin spoke at a rally and rode the parade on an elephant float - a rallying moment for the community, James says

name: House of Aviance
context: Kevin's ball house, founded by Juan Aviance in Washington, D.C.; a month after joining he moved into the house with four others - family to this day

name: Kevin Aviance – 'Din Da Da'
context: His 1997 No. 1 dance hit, a version of George Kranz's song. James says it is now the more iconic of the two; Kevin learned to scat for it and says it is like a language

name: O.J. Simpson's white Bronco chase
context: On TV at the Paramount the morning before Kevin got the call for the Madonna video

name: Beyoncé
context: Sampled Kevin's Cunty on Renaissance without him knowing - he heard it when the album came out. He calls the album a love letter to the Black queer community

name: Pepper LaBeija
context: Also brought to DC for a ball - 'another story', Kevin says, waiting for her coins

name: Juan Aviance
context: Founder and house mother of the House of Aviance. He saw Kevin on the runway at a Sunday party in DC, asked him to join the house and gave him the name Aviance - 'Juan discovered me', Kevin says

name: Kevin's silhouette drag
context: Before he did bald-head drag Kevin did wigs and loved silhouettes - the mud flap girl was his favourite thing in the world, so he hung out in the dark until the light hit him

name: Kevin's Secret video look
heard: leopard outfit / all the gold jewellery
context: Titties, wig, nails and a leopard outfit - until Madonna asked for a smaller bra and all the gold jewellery, Kevin says. He looked and felt better

name: James's tattered wedding dress
context: What James wore when Kevin met him in DC: tattered like fashion, Kevin says - pretty bedraggled by the time it got there, James admits. Miss Havisham indeed

name: Dorian Corey
context: Kevin met her when she was brought to DC: she reminded him of his father's family, and when the lights came up the feathers popped and she was the most glamorous girl. James calls Kevin the Dorian Corey of our times

name: The Cock
context: Kevin's next stop that night - still on 12th and A then, he says

name: Kevin's fifth-grade drag contest
context: His first drag: his sister's dress, I Will Survive at a school talent contest - and he won

name: The attack on Kevin Aviance
context: On 10 June 2006, walking home up First Avenue after the Phoenix and the Cock, Kevin was set on by a group of young men shouting anti-gay slurs. Four pleaded guilty to gang assault as a hate crime in 2007; Kevin says they have served their time

name: Renaissance (Beyoncé album)
context: Beyoncé's 2022 album: Cunty is sampled on it, along with Moi Renee, TS Madison, Big Freedia and Kevin JZ Prodigy

name: Tracks DC
context: Washington, D.C. gay club where James thinks they first met around 1990; Kevin was part of its scene

name: Kindergarten (Washington, D.C. party)
context: The DC party Kevin threw with Jean-Philippe, Paul Aviance, Nita and Dee Dee - they brought James down for it

name: James's pizza-slice outfit
context: How Kevin first saw James in New York - eating pepperoni in the pizza outfit

name: Vogue balls / ballroom scene
context: Kevin walked his first ball in DC as the House of Aviance; today he loves how seriously the young ballroom kids take their tens

name: Naomi Campbell
context: Kevin's DC runway look was a bit Naomi Campbell; he heard the part he played in Madonna's Secret video was first meant for Naomi

name: Kitty Meow
context: South Beach drag star: she and Kevin were rivals when he arrived, he says; James remembers her as a teenage queen and calls her the queen of South Beach now

name: Gianni Versace
context: When he came to South Beach he sat down right next to James on the beach - such a nice guy, James says

name: Harlem
context: Where the Secret video was shot; Kevin had a trailer with his name on it

name: Latin freestyle
context: Kevin's favourite music as a kid; Din Da Da felt like freestyle R&B to him

name: Fenton Bailey
context: Co-host. He points out that George Kranz was on the same label as the Pop Tarts, and asks Kevin how he got through the years after the attack

name: Madonna – 'Secret' music video
context: Kevin got the job through a stylist and a casting call, shot in Harlem, and sat in his trailer from nine in the morning till eleven at night before Madonna called him in

name: TS Madison
context: Also featured on Renaissance; Beyoncé really appreciates her, Kevin says

name: Big Freedia
context: Also featured on Renaissance

name: Ram Jam – 'Black Betty'
context: What Kevin and friends sang jumping out of a trash can at Trax

name: Black Night (Sunday party, Washington, D.C.)

name: Kevin's floor-length hair parted down the middle
heard: long hair to the floor / Morticia Addams

name: Miami
context: James asks Kevin about his move to Miami

name: Darvel Freeman
context: Kevin's friend and make-up artist to this day; he had just moved to South Beach and looked after Kevin when he arrived

name: Circuit parties

name: Vizcaya Museum and Gardens

name: Junior Vasquez
context: The Sound Factory DJ whose records lasted forever; after Kevin's first end-of-night show to The Pressure he came out of the booth and gave him flowers

context: Stones and a circus theme on his face for the HX Pride cover, shot lying on the ground

name: Phoenix bar, East Village
context: East Village gay bar where Kevin went after the HX cover shoot on the night of the 2006 attack

name: Flawless (1999 film)
context: Kevin was in it, with Robert De Niro

name: Kevin Aviance – 'Strut'
context: The comeback song James remembers him performing at Pride the year after the attack

name: COVID-19 pandemic

name: Moi Renee
context: Her Miss Honey closes the same Renaissance track; Kevin cried hearing it and says she would have lived for it - one of the fiercest queens he ever met

name: Brandon Voss
context: New York party promoter Kevin now works with - they don't try to make him one of the girls, he says

name: The piers
context: Kevin's first New York: going to the pier, and how joyous it was - he sees that feeling in the kids now

name: World of Wonder
context: Fenton and Randy's company

name: Jean-Philippe Aviance
context: One of the House of Aviance crew who threw the DC party Kindergarten with Kevin

name: Paul Aviance
